sections.Profile:
"Rip Snorter" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Genco Manufacturing Co. in October 1949. Designed by Harvey Heiss, the game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, and multiple kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Women, Wood Rail, Original Theme
